Dr. Richard Carmona, Former U.S. Surgeon General, Joins Alli Connect Board of Advisors

Alli Connect Announces the Formation of an Advisory Board to Bolster Mental Health Initiatives for First Responders

paragraphs: AlliConnect sells wellness software to public safety agencies that runs peer support teams, check-ins, referrals and clinical connection in one confidential system of record. Its therapist network is pitched as something other than a directory: therapists who understand the work, matched to the person on a guaranteed timeline. That timeline is scheduling within 24 hours and a first appointment within one week. The site puts the vetted clinician network at over 1,200.

Dashboards connect to a department's CAD and RMS, so critical incident types and cumulative exposure trigger workflows automatically and the data comes back anonymized for reporting. Brief, confidential check-ins cover six domains of wellness, and any risk they identify is routed to the wellness team rather than to command. A custom resource center holds the department's own programs, contacts and links rather than a generic wellness library.

Colleen Hilton, a licensed Marriage and Family Therapist who has spent more than 20 years working with police officers, firefighters, paramedics, 911 dispatchers and corrections, founded the company. A testimonial on the home page from S. Ryckman of the Bellingham Fire Department calls AlliConnect a pillar of that organization's peer support and responder wellness program. In April 2024 the company announced an officer wellness program with the Hartselle Police Department. Its trust page lists HIPAA compliance and data protection.

quote.text: AlliConnect carries one thread from the moment a need is identified to the moment the need is met.
